Footprint changes during the year were corporate, not operational: the Registered Office was shifted from Mundra, Kachchh (Gujarat) to Noida (Uttar Pradesh), approved by Special Resolution on July 28, 2025 with the Regional Director, Ahmedabad, order dated February 6, 2026, and the Company's shares were delisted from the NSE with effect from July 15, 2025. An outstanding balance capital commitment in an Alternative Investments Fund is carried in the accounts.
